_description: Three tool calls the editor must refuse, with the exact texts of ARCHITECTURE section 4.2 and 10.4 (tests/fixtures/proj): an old_string that is not in main.tex, one that occurs twice (\begin{proof}), and a path outside the project root. The turn fails (a JSON-RPC error) if any reply is not an error containing that text.

default.say: Trying three edits that should all be refused.

tool.name: edit

args.old_string: This sentence does not occur anywhere in the document.

tool.expect_error: old_string not found — the user may have edited this region; call read_file

tool.name: edit
tool.expect_error: old_string matches 2 times; add context or set replace_all

default.say: All three edits were refused, as expected.
